Dear @someone, I’m publicly requesting a **FREE display replacement for my Google Pixel 8 Pro.** 

I bought this phone with a year of hard-earned savings from my first job. On September 18, a pink line appeared on my display, and on October 8, a second line appeared after I followed the troubleshooting instructions provided by your support team.

After weeks of emails, submitting photos, videos, and a bug report, and escalating my case to your highest support team, Google has still refused a free replacement and offered only paid repair.

**My warranty expiring should not automatically mean I must pay for a recurring display issue that appeared after software updates.** I’m also disappointed that the Pixel 8 receives an extended warranty program while the Pixel 8 Pro is excluded.

This phone was a dream I worked hard to afford. I trusted Google, but this experience has left me deeply disappointed. I’m not asking for a discount or special treatment. I’m asking Google to take responsibility and provide a **FREE display replacement for my Pixel 8 Pro, without charging me for parts or labour.**

Please don’t respond with another standard warranty-policy explanation. My case has already been reviewed repeatedly. I want a fair, concrete resolution.

**Google, please stand behind your product and make this right.** 

#GooglePixel #Pixel8Pro #GoogleSupport #PixelPinkLine #RightToRepair
